insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified in extract (Base Sum Insured + Booster+ SI + Safeguard/Safeguard+ SI + ReAssure+/ReAssureX as per Policy Schedule/variant)

great.name: Room rent: No limit / any room (choose the room you like)
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: Default room rent is not capped (no Single AC-only limit or ₹/day cap stated). Your total Sum Insured can get consumed faster if you choose higher rooms.

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer / unlimited reload (ReAssure+ / ReAssureX)
great.quote: “ReAssure “Forever”: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: Provides extra Sum Insured that activates after base SI is used, and can trigger repeatedly (subject to per-claim limit up to Base Sum Insured).

great.name: Restore benefit: Unlimited, can support repeated claims (per-claim top-up up to Base SI)
great.quote: “Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured... (this 10 Lakh will trigger unlimited times)”
great.explanation: This functions as a very strong restore/reload mechanism: after the first paid claim, additional SI becomes available for subsequent claims repeatedly (as described in the illustration).

great.name: Pre-existing disease waiting period option as low as 12 months (variant-based)
great.quote: “Pre-existing Diseases... shall be excluded until the expiry of 12months/24 months/ 36 months (as per Variant selected) of continuous coverage”
great.explanation: If you choose the 12-month variant, PED waiting is best-in-class. (Longer variants are still acceptable, but 12 months is the standout.)

great.name: Specified disease/procedure waiting period option as low as 12 months (variant-based)
great.quote: “Specified disease/procedure... excluded until the expiry of 24 months/12 months (as per Variant Selected)”
great.reference: Section 5.1.2 Specified disease/procedure waiting period (Code- Excl02)
great.explanation: If you choose the 12-month variant, this is better than the standard 24 months.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (standard)
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident”
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting for illnesses; accidents are covered from day 1.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 60 days
good.quote: “We will pay expenses... for 60 days before the date of admission”
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for the same condition for up to 60 days pre-hospitalization (standard-good).

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 180 days
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for the same condition for up to 180 days post-hospitalization (good standard).

good.name: Domiciliary / home care treatment covered
good.quote: “Home Care Treatment means treatment availed by the insured person at home... would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken at home...”
good.explanation: Home care is covered when medically advised and monitored, subject to conditions stated.

good.name: Air ambulance covered (limit up to Base Sum Insured; emergency only)
good.quote: “Air Ambulance: Only in case of Emergency. We will pay up to Base Sum Insured.”
good.reference: Section 4.1.1(a)-(b) Expenses in reaching a Hospital
good.explanation: Air ambulance is covered for emergencies (any limit qualifies as good).

good.name: Modern treatments covered (listed) up to Base Sum Insured
good.quote: “We pay for Modern treatments, up to Base Sum Insured for the list as specified below...”
good.explanation: Modern treatments are covered but tied to Base SI and a specified list (not stated as “no sub-limits for all modern treatments”).

good.name: Optional cover: Borderless (worldwide planned/emergency treatment) with selectable co-pay
good.quote: “Borderless... Choose from a range of co-payments options 0%, 20%, 30%, 40% & 50%”
good.explanation: Optional worldwide treatment benefit. Co-pay is a customer choice depending on option selected.

good.name: Optional cover: Safeguard / Safeguard+ includes non-payable item coverage (consumables-like items) + inflation-linked SI increase
good.quote: “Claim Safeguard: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I – Expenses not covered’ of Annexure I’.”
good.reference: Section 4.1.20.1.1 Claim Safeguard and Annexure I
good.explanation: As an optional benefit, it can reduce out-of-pocket on non-payable items (and also offers inflation-linked Base SI increases). Since it is not stated as default, treated as an optional enhancement.

good.name: Optional add-on/benefits available (deductible, co-payment, room type modification, OPD/wellness)
good.quote: “Optional Benefit: 4.1.14. Annual Aggregate Deductible” / “4.1.16. Co-Payment” / “4.1.18. Room Type Modification” / “4.1.25. WellConsult (OPD): Opt for complete wellness and OPD benefits.”
good.explanation: The policy offers multiple optional levers (deductible/co-pay/room type modification/OPD) to tailor premium vs coverage.

bad.name: NCB / Renewal bonus: Not found (assumed not covered)
bad.quote: Not mentioned in the provided policy wording extract.
bad.explanation: No NCB stated here: Sum Insured growth at renewal via NCB is not evidenced in the extract. (Policy has other SI growth mechanisms like Booster+/Safeguard, but NCB itself is not specified.)

bad.name: Consumables / non-payable items (default): Not covered (only via optional Safeguard/Safeguard+)
bad.quote: “The expenses that are not covered... Annexure I - The expenses that are not covered...”
bad.reference: Section 6.2.4(c) and Annexure I; plus Safeguard description in 4.1.20/4.1.21
bad.explanation: By default, many consumables/non-payable items are excluded (Annexure I). They are covered only if you opt for Safeguard/Safeguard+; otherwise these can be out-of-pocket.

unclear.name: Co-pay (base plan): percentage not specified
unclear.quote: “Co-Payment: It is the percentage of admissible claim amount You would have to bear for every claim, Rest we will pay.”
unclear.explanation: The existence of a co-pay option is stated, but the actual co-pay % applicable to your policy depends on what you opt for / what is in the Policy Schedule. Verify whether default is 0% or some %.

unclear.name: Cashless network size (number of hospitals) not specified
unclear.quote: “Cashless claim facility is available at our network hospitals ONLY... for the latest list, refer to our website www.nivabupa.com.”
unclear.explanation: Network exists but the document does not state the count (e.g., 7,000/10,000+).

unclear.name: Restore/reload variant: whether ReAssure+ or ReAssureX applies to you
unclear.quote: “Either ReAssure+ or ReAssureX can be offered in a single policy.”
unclear.explanation: Both are described, but your policy will have only one. Confirm from your Policy Schedule which one is included.

unclear.name: Specific room entitlement if Room Type Modification is chosen (and related co-pay/pro-rata impact)
unclear.quote: “Room Type Modification... You can choose between a Standard Single Room and a Shared Room up to Sum Insured... You will have to bear additional co-payment IF treatment is taken in a higher room category than the eligible room category”
unclear.explanation: Default seems ‘no limit’ on room choice, but if you opt for Room Type Modification, room eligibility changes and extra co-pay applies for higher room. Confirm if you are opting for this modification.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
